## One source, many outputs

- Write with Markdown.
- Include code and its results.
- Publish documents, reports, and presentations.

::: {.notes}
Press S while presenting to open the speaker view. These notes are visible
to the presenter, rather than on the audience slide.
:::

## The workflow

::: {.incremental}
- Create a `.qmd` file.
- Add a YAML header to choose the output format.
- Preview, revise, and render.
:::

## Text and code, side by side

### Explain the idea

Code fences make examples easy to read. This example displays code without
executing it.

values = [10, 20, 30]
average = sum(values) / len(values)

## Try it yourself

```bash
quarto preview 03-slides.qmd
```

Use the arrow keys to move between slides.
